t0314-01.gloss: A personal trace places field-program residue before a later restriction.
t0314-01.rival_reading: Emergency workers could have encountered the same residue while responding; the personal trace does not by itself prove the field program caused the emergency.

t0314-02.gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
t0314-02.rival_reading: A response to an agricultural exposure could explain the same record or object.
